reason: A web-only theme customization plugin that extracts a palette from a local image, applies glass-style theme tokens, and uses the image as a configurable background; the README states that image processing and storage remain browser-local.

summaries.zh: 一款将本地图片转换为配色并应用为可调背景和玻璃风格界面的 DeepSeek Harness 主题插件。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness theme plugin that extracts colors from a local image and applies them as an adjustable background and glass-style interface theme.

capabilities: Accepts image uploads or drag-and-drop input in the browser
Extracts a five-color palette locally from the selected image
Overrides host theme tokens and renders the image as a background
Stores the image and settings in browser-local IndexedDB and localStorage
